instruction: I am going on a vacation. Move my go-to-sleep phone alarm to 20 minutes later and disable the rest.
notes: Single-app (phone) task. Login username is the supervisor's phone number, obtained via supervisor.show_profile (gated by profile-known); the password via supervisor.show_account_passwords. phone.show_alarms yields (alarms-listed), standing for knowledge of every alarm's id, label, time and enabled status. A single phone-update-alarm action maps to phone.update_alarm with parameters (alarm_id, access_token, time, enabled); because the task needs two different partial updates (time-only for the go-to-sleep alarm, enabled=false-only for every other enabled alarm) and conditional effects are not allowed, the exact optional arguments to pass per alarm are encoded as static facts required-time-arg / required-enabled-arg, with placeholder objects time-omitted / flag-omitted meaning the optional argument is left out of the call (this keeps the changed-field sets to {time} and {enabled} as the evaluation requires). (not (alarm-updated ?al)) guarantees each alarm is updated exactly once. Alarm entities are domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can enumerate all goal conditions without quantifiers; the number of other enabled alarms is runtime-dependent, the problem instantiates two representative ones (alarm-other-1, alarm-other-2); at runtime one disable call is made per enabled non-target alarm and already-disabled alarms need no call. No answer is passed to complete_task. The reference solution's second show_alarms call is redundant and omitted.
